title: Protocol effects on feature-based hardware-Trojan detection across Trust-Hub families
abstract: arXiv:2609.07199v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Trust-Hub reuses host circuits: several files differ mainly in the inserted Trojan. When gates from sibling variants enter both training and test folds, a detector can benefit from host logic it has already seen. We measure that effect instead of proposing another classifier. The corpus contains 49,124 gates from 16 netlists grouped into five host families. We left the parser, 36 gate features, class weighting, model settings, threshold, and family-level aggregation unchanged and altered one choice: the test boundary. The three settings draw test gates from the pooled corpus, withhold a complete netlist, or withhold every variant of one host. The choice matters. Random forest records F1/AP of 0.914/0.978 with pooled gates, 0.636/0.851 with one netlist held out, and 0.460/0.577 with a host family held out. XGBoost falls from 0.946/0.976 to 0.464/0.544 across the same comparison. Logistic regression loses AP, although its fixed-threshold

translated_title: 测试协议设置对跨 Trust-Hub 家族基于特征的硬件木马检测的影响
translated_abstract: Trust-Hub 复用宿主电路：多个文件之间的主要区别仅在于插入的木马。当同一家族兄弟变体的门电路同时进入训练集和测试集时，检测器可以从已经见过的宿主逻辑中获益。我们测量的是这种效应，而不是提出又一种分类器。语料库包含来自 16 个网表的 49,124 个门电路，分为五个宿主家族。我们保持解析器、36 个门级特征、类别权重、模型设置、阈值和家族级聚合方式不变，仅改变一个选择：测试集边界。三种设置分别从合并语料库中抽取测试门电路、留出一个完整网表、或留出一个宿主的所有变体。这一选择至关重要：随机森林在合并门电路下 F1/AP 为 0.914/0.978，留出一个完整网表时降至 0.636/0.851，留出一个宿主家族时仅为 0.460/0.577；在同样对比下，XGBoost 从 0.946/0.976 下降到 0.464/0.544；逻辑回归损失了 AP，尽管其固定阈值……
tldr: 该论文发现基于特征的硬件木马检测性能严重依赖测试集划分协议——当测试门电路来自训练中已见过的宿主电路时性能被高估，而按宿主家族留出时 F1/AP 会从约 0.91/0.98 骤降至约 0.46/0.58。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that feature-based hardware-Trojan detection is highly protocol-dependent: reported performance is inflated when test gates share host circuits with training data, dropping from F1/AP of ~0.91/0.98 to ~0.46/0.58 when entire host families are held out.
